title: 28:15 We have made a covenant with death/hell. Judah's leaders, against the Lord's counsel, made a covenant with Egypt to fight Assyria in hopes that they (Judah) might free themselves from Assyria's rule (30:1; 31:1). Judah's stand against Assyria and her trust in Egypt's might and power jeopardized the lives of the people of Judah, because they did not rely on the Lord; hence, Judah was signing her own death warrant, called by Isaiah a covenant with death.
author: Tina M. Peterson
